gloss: Boys' Day festival; Dragon Boat Festival

definitions.gloss: Boys' Day festival; Dragon Boat Festival
definitions.explanation: A traditional festival on May 5th celebrating the health and growth of boys. Families display warrior dolls, fly carp streamers, and eat special foods like kashiwamochi and chimaki.

examples.japanese: {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}に{鯉|こい}のぼりを{飾|かざ}る。
examples.english: We put up carp streamers for Boys' Day.

examples.japanese: {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}には{柏餅|かしわもち}を{食|た}べる{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: There is a custom of eating kashiwamochi on Boys' Day.

examples.japanese: {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}は{五月|ごがつ}{五日|いつか}で、{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}の{健|すこ}やかな{成長|せいちょう}を{願|ねが}う{行事|ぎょうじ}だ。
examples.english: The Boys' Day festival is on May 5th and is an event to pray for the healthy growth of boys.

notes:
CULTURE:
One of the {五節句|ごせっく} (five seasonal festivals). May 5th is also a national holiday called こどもの{日|ひ} (Children's Day). Traditional decorations include {五月人形|ごがつにんぎょう} (warrior dolls), {鯉|こい}のぼり (carp streamers symbolizing strength and perseverance), and {兜|かぶと} (samurai helmets). Special foods include {柏餅|かしわもち} and {粽|ちまき}. Families also take {菖蒲湯|しょうぶゆ} (iris baths) to ward off evil.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}を{祝|いわ}う (to celebrate Boys' Day)
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}の{飾|かざ}り (Boys' Day decorations)
- {端午|たんご}の{節句|せっく}に{ちなんだ} (associated with Boys' Day)
